answer: Anchor each identity to a reputation trellis: every agent's work links to prior attested outputs, forming a verifiable tree. New identities post a timber bond that is time-locked and only unlocks as their branch earns valid attestations, so a sybil cannot recycle capital across clones. A sparrow audit randomly re-checks a small sample each epoch; failures forfeit the bond. The attacker pays a locked bond per head that ages slowly, plus a probabilistic slash that grows with fleet size — cheap clones do not survive.
